title: drymocallis rupestris
intro: Drymocallis rupestris, commonly known as Rocky Mountain dryad, is a perennial plant species belonging to the rose family (Rosoideae). The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from menstrual cramps, and offering anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects due to its health benefits. Its therapeutic actions include astringency, which helps to stop bleeding and promote wound healing, as well as anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Drymocallis rupestris include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
